section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: The ErrorLog module will record errors which occur within the desktop. These are logged to the SysLog 'Errors', and can be referred to after the error has occurred. In addition, the module will set two system variables :

sysvar-definition.name: Error$
sysvar-definition.description: Error message of the last Wimp error box

use.p: This variable is set by the ErrorLog module to the error message in the last Wimp error box.

sysvar-definition.name: Error$Task
sysvar-definition.description: Task running when the last Wimp error box was displayed

use.p: This variable is set by the ErrorLog module to the task running when the last Wimp error box was displayed.
